translations.web: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
translations.bsb: With his wife’s full knowledge, he kept back some of the proceeds for himself, but brought a portion and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
